name: Moon Card
summary: Prepaid virtual cards funded with Bitcoin via Lightning Network. Create disposable cards for online purchases.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the Moon Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: Yes — it charges US$20 per month. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Moon Card?
faq.answer: It charges about 3% on non-base-currency spending.
